title: Atom-free L2 derivative suffices for integrable holonomy amplitude

sobolev_sufficiency.hypothesis: G is compactly supported, absolutely continuous, scalar or finite-dimensional vector valued, with weak derivative g=G' in L2.
sobolev_sufficiency.atom_free: The distributional derivative is DG=g d omega and therefore has no atoms.
sobolev_sufficiency.fourier_identity: For t nonzero, widehat G(t)=widehat g(t)/(it).
sobolev_sufficiency.tail: Cauchy-Schwarz and Plancherel give int_(|t|>R)|widehat G(t)|dt<=2sqrt(pi/R)||g||_2.
sobolev_sufficiency.conclusion: widehat G belongs to L1, providing a sufficient atom-free subclass complementary to K1624's necessary condition.
sobolev_sufficiency.scope_guard: The theorem does not cover arbitrary atom-free singular-continuous derivative measures and does not prove electric-field L1 or nonlinear-flow remainder control.
